blocks.value: One of the first things traders and investors look for is the trend. A trend tells us the overall direction in which a stock is moving.
Imagine This: You're walking uphill on a mountain. Even if you occasionally step down to avoid a rock, your overall direction is still upward. Stock prices behave in the same way.
There are three main types of trends: Uptrend, Downtrend and Sideways Trend.
If a stock keeps making higher highs and higher lows, it is generally in an Uptrend.
The trend is your friend. Never ignore the overall direction of the market.

blocks.question: What does a trend show?
choices: The overall direction of a stock's movement.
